scope.game_type_route: Use the augmented model on R rows only; preserve exact parent C predictions on F rows.
scope.candidate_complexity: one CatBoost outcome recipe with one fixed deterministic feature bundle

teacher_scoring.history_rule: For completed source season S, fit both teachers on matched R rows with season strictly less than S and score S using its now-historical TrackMan physics.
teacher_scoring.teacher_models: exact control and physics_teacher recipes from V5_PRIVILEGED_TRACKMAN_TEACHER_FEASIBILITY_V1
teacher_scoring.confirmation_rule: Do not generate source-season 2023 teacher scores unless the 2022/2023 development gate passes and the recipe is locked.

profile_features.source_cutoff: teacher-scored completed seasons strictly before each modeled row season
season_centering: physics_teacher_probability minus control_teacher_probability, then minus its source-season mean

candidate_change: Add only trackman_teacher to the exact parent feature list; hold all model parameters, drops, training rows, seeds, and routing fixed.

development_gate.bootstrap: pitcher-cluster 95% interval, 1000 fixed-seed replicates in final selector
requirements: positive R point gain over exact parent C in both 2022 and 2023
positive R 95% gain lower bound over exact parent C in both 2022 and 2023
positive routed-full point gain over exact parent C in both 2022 and 2023
positive R point gain over both required honest R anchors in both 2022 and 2023
development_gate.on_fail: reject without generating 2023 teacher scores or running 2024
development_gate.on_pass: freeze the exact recipe and generate only the deterministic source-2023 scores needed for locked 2024 confirmation
